notes: Causal families on DECAF-style discovered graphs instead of the hand-drawn ones: FGES (Tetrad, BDeu score, default parameters) on each seed's training split, with age and the birth-fixed protected attributes declared root nodes as in DECAF App. D.3, the outcome declared a sink, and the CPDAG oriented by a consistent extension (scripts/discover_graphs.py; graphs in src/causal_fairness_sdg/data/discovered_graphs/). Non-private families only: DECAF (GAN), DECAF+CTGAN, DECAF+Diffusion, DECAF+TabPFN; the DP variants are left out because a graph learned from the training rows without noise would void their guarantee. Same datasets, role splits, seeds and classifier as facct-2026-10-09; the hand-graph counterpart of the decaf_tabpfn rows is in that batch. Torch epochs: the settings tables as of this commit (100 for the SNAKE-like datasets, tuned values for Adult and COMPAS).
